scope: One voice, period four; this does not close issue 140 or establish C64 generation.

teaching.policy: wrong or refused answer only; cold local teacher on the same pre-act drive

history.placement: first three coordinates of the existing 32-wide prefrontal region; no projection rescaling
history.ownership: native Trace updates settled sensory activation once after each issued act; present act reads history through the preceding event; labels never write the trace
history.original_control: association source, all 32 original prefrontal coordinates, same amplitude and decay
history.lesion: after every prime and loop act, zero only sensory-history coordinates zero and one; retain constant-coordinate two exactly

gates.every_prime: must beat matched untaught, event-only lesion, and every other phase continuation
gates.preservation: all planned founders must pass imagination isolation, pending next-learning continuation and restored outputs; candidate, untaught, lesion and restored controls permit no refused act/lesson or exhausted teaching phase; preservation diagnostic sampled actions, eligibility, feedback and imagination must stay below their declared budgets
gates.association_control: old-recipe scores, refusals, phase exhaustion and exceptions are reported independently; they do not veto candidate admission or erase acquired candidate evidence

admission: Full mode runs confirmation only after at least five of all six development founders pass, with every development preservation check passing. Missing/failed founders remain in denominators.
selection: Trace source was selected on development evidence. Decay 0.2 retains the original timescale; no runtime default changes. Repeating seeds 1601-1605 is a reproduction of the recorded confirmation, not new fresh evidence.
